mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, p.name AS pet_name FROM bill b JOIN customer c ON c.id = b.customer_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.id = b.pet_id

where.if: AND (b.pet_id = #{petId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bill_item bi WHERE bi.bill_id = b.id AND bi.pet_id = #{petId}))
AND (b.bill_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.phone LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill b JOIN customer c ON c.id = b.customer_id
WHERE b.customer_id = #{customerId} AND b.status != 'OPEN' ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
WHERE b.status = 'SETTLED' AND b.business_date = #{date} ORDER BY b.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill WHERE bill_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill(bill_no, bill_type, customer_id, pet_id, status, total_cent, discount_cent, receivable_cent, received_cent, pay_method, business_date, settled_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, request_id, operator, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{billType}, #{customerId}, #{petId}, #{status}, #{totalCent}, #{discountCent}, #{receivableCent}, #{receivedCent}, #{payMethod}, #{businessDate}, #{settledAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{requestId}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bill SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SETTLED'
